fields: L6 Hong Kong / Mid-Autumn Festival (inline roller skates; Central → Victoria Harbour → The Peak). Same item fields as L3 v3.1 / L4 / L5. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = 月饼摊 Mooncake Stall questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh must equal choices; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12 where CJK=1, ASCII=0.5), peak_final = The Peak / 太平山顶 final (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational, no bare arithmetic). Per run: 3 timed stall in segment 1 + 4 fork in segment 2 + 2 timed stall and 1 Peak final in segment 3 = 10 (one stall pool, drawn as 5 then split 3+2; do not place all 5 timed questions in the first segment). Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Festival riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'), labelled Festival riddle: / 中秋谜：. Stems are deduped against all L1–L5 banks (all grades).

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A lantern costs 120 yuan. It is 10% off at the mooncake stall. What is the new price in yuan?
questions.q_zh: 一盏灯笼 120 元，月饼摊便宜 10%，现价多少元？

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: On the Peak, Flora sees a far lantern-bearer's arm move, then hears a call. The delay is because ____.
questions.q_zh: 在太平山，Flora 先看见远处提灯人的手臂动了，然后才听见叫声。有延迟，是因为____。
choices: light reaches her faster than sound
skates store the sound in the wheels
choices_zh: 轮滑把声音存在轮子里
questions.explain_en: Light travels much faster than sound.

questions.subject: language
questions.q_en: At the Peak, the officer quotes 但愿人长久，千里共婵娟 while they share a mooncake. The line is mainly about ____.
questions.q_zh: 在太平山，警察叔叔一边分月饼一边念“但愿人长久，千里共婵娟”。这句主要是说____。
choices: wishing people far apart well under the same moon
counting how many trams are left
choices_zh: 祝不在一起的人平安，共看同一轮明月
questions.explain_en: The line is a Mid-Autumn wish about the shared moon.
questions.explain_zh: 这是中秋时关于共看明月的祝福。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: From the foot of a lamp post at the harbour, a rope runs to a point 24 m along the deck; the pole is 10 m tall. How long is the rope from the top of the pole, in metres?
questions.q_zh: 维港一根灯柱高 10 米，从杆顶拉一根绳子到地面离杆脚 24 米的地方，绳长多少米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A cylindrical festival drum at the harbour has radius 5 dm and height 25 dm. Using π ≈ 3.14, what is its volume in dm³?
questions.q_zh: 维港一面圆柱形节日鼓底面半径 5 分米、高 25 分米，π 取 3.14，体积是多少立方分米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A sketch of the Peak lookoutway is 3 cm wide and 5 cm tall. A similar banner copy is 15 cm wide. How tall is the banner in cm?
questions.q_zh: 太平山观景台的草图宽 3 厘米、高 5 厘米，放大成相似的横幅后宽 15 厘米，高是多少厘米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Mooncakes are set out at the Peak following L = 8 + 9n, where n is minutes after the doors open. How many mooncakes are out when n = 7?
questions.q_zh: 太平山的月饼按 L = 8 + 9n 摆出，n 是开门后的分钟数。n = 7 时摆出了多少块？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: On a Hong Kong map, 1 cm stands for 200 m. The path from the harbour to the Peak is 12 cm on the map. How many metres is it really?
questions.q_zh: 香港地图上 1 厘米代表 200 米，从维港到太平山的路在图上长 12 厘米，实际是多少米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A round festival drum at the harbour has a diameter of 80 cm. Using π ≈ 3.14, how many cm of ribbon go once around it?
questions.q_zh: 维港一面节日圆鼓直径 80 厘米，π 取 3.14，绕它一圈的彩带要多少厘米？
